events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Sam Bennett scored 10 seconds into the third period, Brad Marchand had two assists and the Florida Panthers beat the Los Angeles Kings 3-2 on Wednesday night to sweep the two-game season series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bennett scores big goal early in 3rd, Panthers stay hot by topping Kings 3-2 for 6th win in 7 games

events.name: Utah Mammoth at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Clayton Keller had a goal and an assist as the Utah Mammoth pulled away from the Atlantic Division-leading Detroit Red Wings 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keller and Mammoth slow down Atlantic Division-leading Red Wings, 4-1

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Justin Faulk scored and Joel Hofer made 24 saves to lift the St. Louis Blues to a 1-0 win over the stumbling Winnipeg Jets on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Faulk scores only goal of game, Hofer makes 24 saves to help Blues blank Jets 1-0

headlines.description: — Sebastian Aho scored two goals and added an assist as the Carolina Hurricanes defeated the Nashville Predators 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aho's two goals, assist lead Hurricanes over Predators 4-1

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Jesper Bratt scored the winning goal in a shootout and the New Jersey Devils defeated the Vegas Golden Knights, 2-1, on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jesper Bratt notches winner in shootout as Devils top Golden Knights in Vegas, 2-1
